bibl.title: Θρασώ / Σαθρώ.
bibl.note: The Fayyūmic toponym Θρασώ, usually connected with Coptic ⲧⲉⲣⲥⲱ, is sometimes attested in the plausibly metathetic variant Σαθρώ. The same peculiar Distanzmetathese occurs in the outcome σαθρ- > θρασ- attested in many Modern Greek dialects.
